PRENATAL CYTOGENETICS REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory

PATIENT: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
HOSPITAL NUMBER: [redacted ID]
REFERRING CLINICIAN: Dr. [redacted name]
DATE OF SAMPLE: [redacted date]
DATE OF REPORT: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Prenatal testing at 11 weeks gestation by ultrasound for screening of chromosomal abnormalities and aneuploidy assessment.

SAMPLE TYPE
Chorionic villi sample (CVS)

TEST REQUESTED
Karyotype analysis

RESULT
SAMPLE UNSUITABLE FOR TESTING

No chorionic villi material present in sample.

INTERPRETATION
The submitted sample did not contain adequate chorionic villi tissue for chromosome analysis. Without viable fetal tissue, karyotype analysis cannot be performed. Therefore, we are unable to provide genetic assessment for chromosomal abnormalities including common aneuploidies.

RECOMMENDATIONS
1. Consider repeat chorionic villus sampling if gestational age permits
2. Alternatively, amniocentesis may be offered from 15 weeks gestation
3. If rapid aneuploidy detection for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21 is still required, PCR-based testing (QF-PCR) on amniotic fluid may be considered
4. Please contact the genetics laboratory to discuss alternative testing options

This result has been discussed with the referring clinician.

Authorised by: [redacted name]
Consultant Clinical Scientist
[redacted date]
